resources.string: Sign in to manage your hospital appointments.
Register as a patient to get started with MediBook.
Enter a valid phone number with 7–15 digits.
You are signed in to MediBook as a patient. Doctor browsing and appointments will be added in a later step.
Unable to verify your account online. Check your connection and sign in again.
Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
This password does not meet the account security requirements. Choose a stronger password.
This email is already registered. Use Login. If a previous profile setup failed, contact the hospital administrator.
Unable to sign in. Check your email and password, or contact the hospital administrator if your account is unavailable.
Email/password sign-in is unavailable. Contact the hospital administrator.
Your patient profile could not be accessed. Contact the hospital administrator to check Firestore permissions.
Your account has no patient profile. You have been signed out. Contact the hospital administrator to complete or repair registration.
Your patient profile is incomplete or invalid. You have been signed out. Contact the hospital administrator.
This flow is for Patient accounts only. No Admin access has been granted. You have been signed out.

Registration was not completed because the patient profile could not be saved. The new sign-in account was removed. Check your connection and ask the administrator to verify Firestore rules before registering again.

Registration was not completed. The patient profile could not be saved, and the new sign-in account could not be removed. You have been signed out. Contact the hospital administrator before retrying with this email.
The request could not be completed. Please try again. If this continues, contact the hospital administrator.
